rule: 2026-09; USD; store-local dates. Month determined independently by order, payment, completion and settlement date.
Quantity × charged unit price less line discount; merchandise only. Catalog prices never replace historical prices.
Only succeeded refunds with completion in month reduce sales; includes returns of earlier orders. Approved amounts retained.
Only captured transactions count. Each payment_id counted once. Explicit order ID, then exact order: reference; no amount-only matching.
Latest record_version per line_id. Exact repeated payment_id/refund_id rows removed. Conflicting same-ID records stop the run for review.
Known ID or loyalty reference authoritative; otherwise exact normalized contact/name evidence must resolve to one person. Conflicting/shared contacts stay unresolved. No fuzzy name merging.
Net merchandise sales by SKU and resolved customer; monthly sold orders count once. Returned prior-month orders reported separately. WALK-IN and UNRESOLVED are pools, not customers.
Card charge fees by payment date shown separately from refund fee credits and fees by settlement date.
Net external receipts exclude gift redemption and fees. Expected payout uses settlement dates and includes earlier-month charges. Neither confirms bank deposits.

Bank statement/deposit export; terminal receipts linking unmatched charges; corrected contact/loyalty evidence; confirmation of unresolved refunds; opening gift-card liability; cash deposit/till records.
Use run_month.command or python reconcile.py --input INPUT_FOLDER --month YYYY-MM. See README.md. Regenerate rather than editing output totals.
